author: D

components.title: Compute LCM of intervals
components.what: Find least common multiple of 12, 18, and 30 minutes to get the common departure cycle.

components.title: Add cycle time to start
components.what: Add the LCM (in hours/minutes) to the 06:00 start time to get the next simultaneous departure.

log.author: B
log.draft:
12 = 2² × 3, 18 = 2 × 3², and 30 = 2 × 3 × 5. Taking the highest power of each prime gives LCM = 2² × 3² × 5 = 180 minutes. [c1]

This can be checked by verifying 180 ÷ 12 = 15, 180 ÷ 18 = 10, and 180 ÷ 30 = 6; 180 is divisible by all three intervals. [c1][c2]

Adding 180 minutes (3 hours) to 06:00 gives 09:00. [c1][c2]

FINAL: 09:00

challenges.problem: Divisibility by all three intervals only shows 180 is a common multiple, not that it is the least common multiple. If a smaller common multiple existed, the next departure could be earlier than 09:00. The draft asserts the LCM is 180 but does not rule out smaller common multiples.

The prime factorization of 18 is 2 × 3², so the highest power of 3 across 12 (2² × 3), 18 (2 × 3²), and 30 (2 × 3 × 5) is 3². The draft correctly uses 3², but the check that follows does not verify the prime-power selection; it only verifies divisibility. A reader could accept 180 as a common multiple without confirming it is minimal.

The addition is correct only if 180 minutes is the least common multiple. If the LCM were smaller, the next departure would be earlier. The draft's verification that 180 is divisible by all three intervals does not exclude a smaller common multiple, so the conclusion rests on an unproven premise within the draft's own reasoning.

log.answer:
12 = 2² × 3, 18 = 2 × 3², 30 = 2 × 3 × 5. Taking the highest power of each prime gives LCM = 2² × 3² × 5 = 180 minutes. To confirm 180 is the least common multiple, list the multiples of 30 below 180: 30, 60, 90, 120, 150. None is divisible by both 12 and 18 (60 and 120 are divisible by 12 but not 18; 90 is divisible by 18 but not 12; 30 and 150 are divisible by neither). Thus the next common departure is after 180 minutes. 180 minutes = 3 hours, so 06:00 + 3 hours = 09:00.
FINAL: 09:00
